questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct representation of a rational number?
questions.solution: The number -5/3 is a rational number because it can be expressed in the form p/q where p and q are integers and q ≠ 0. The other options are not rational numbers as they either have a zero denominator or involve irrational numbers.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक परिमेय संख्या का सही प्रतिनिधित्व है?
hi.solution: संख्या -5/3 एक परिमेय संख्या है क्योंकि इसे p/q के रूप में व्यक्त किया जा सकता है जहाँ p और q पूर्णांक हैं और q ≠ 0। अन्य विकल्प परिमेय संख्याएँ नहीं हैं क्योंकि ये या तो शून्य हर वाली संख्या हैं या अपरिमेय संख्याओं के साथ आती हैं।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, technical terms are appropriately used in Hindi.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणते एक अपरिमेय संख्येचे योग्य प्रतिनिधित्व आहे?
mr.solution: संख्या -5/3 अपरिमेय संख्या आहे कारण ती p/q च्या रूपात व्यक्त केली जाऊ शकते जेथे p आणि q पूर्णांक असतात आणि q ≠ 0. इतर विकल्प परिमेय संख्या नाहीत कारण त्यांमध्ये शून्य छेद असतो किंवा अपरिमेय संख्यांचा समावेश असतो.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct representation of a rational number on a number line?
choices: Dividing the unit into 3 equal parts and marking the 2nd point
Dividing the unit into 2 equal parts and marking the 1st point
Dividing the unit into 4 equal parts and marking the 5th point
Dividing the unit into 5 equal parts and marking the 7th point
questions.solution: To represent a rational number like 2/3 on a number line, the unit should be divided into 3 equal parts, and the 2nd point should be marked. This is a correct representation of a rational number on a number line. The other options involve incorrect divisions or markings.

questions.stem: What is the value of the expression 1/2 + 1/3?
questions.solution: To add 1/2 and 1/3, we find the common denominator, which is 6. Converting both fractions, we get 3/6 + 2/6 = 5/6. The other options are incorrect due to miscalculations.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of an irrational number that can be shown on a number line?
questions.solution: The number √2 is an irrational number that can be shown on a number line. It is a non-terminating and non-repeating decimal. The other options are rational numbers, which can also be shown on a number line, but they are not irrational.
